legend: One cold and foggy night, you walk down a shady alley. There should be a lamp every few metres but none of them seem to work, and in this night, not even the moon enlightens your path. Alone and in the dark, you wonder: "Even if there was a working lamp somewhere, how much would it lighten my way?". Now, back at home, you want to calculate this.

The alley can be modelled as a line with a length of n$$$n$$$ metres. The fog has a uniform density and reduces the light of a lamp by a factor of 1−p$$$1-p$$$ every metre. The brightness at one point is the sum of the light that reaches this point from every lamp. You want to calculate this brightness at some points after placing some lamps.
input: One line with two integers n$$$n$$$ and q$$$q$$$ and one real number p$$$p$$$ (1≤n,q≤2⋅105,0<p<1$$$1\leq n, q\leq 2\cdot10^5, 0  \lt  p  \lt  1$$$),   the length of the alley, the number of queries and the density of the fog.   The density p$$$p$$$ of the fog will be given with at most 6$$$6$$$ digits behind the decimal point.

q$$$q$$$ lines containing one of three query types:   [noitemsep,topsep=0pt,parsep=0pt,partopsep=0pt]     "+ b x" given two integers b$$$b$$$ and x$$$x$$$ (1≤b≤109$$$1\leq b \leq 10^9$$$ and 1≤x≤n$$$1\leq x \leq n$$$), place a lamp with brightness b$$$b$$$ at position x$$$x$$$.

"- b x" given integers b$$$b$$$ and x$$$x$$$ (1≤b≤109$$$1\leq b \leq 10^9$$$ and 1≤x≤n$$$1\leq x \leq n$$$), remove a lamp with brightness b$$$b$$$ at position x$$$x$$$.    It is guaranteed that a lamp with that brightness was placed there earlier.
"? x" given one integer x$$$x$$$ (1≤x≤n$$$1\leq x \leq n$$$), calculate the brightness at position x$$$x$$$.
output: It can be shown that the brightness can be calculated as a fraction PQ$$$\frac{P}{Q}$$$ where Q$$$Q$$$ is not divisible by 109+7$$$10^9+7$$$.  For each query of type "?", print the brightness as P⋅Q−1mod109+7$$$P\cdot Q^{-1} \bmod 10^9+7$$$ in a single line.

legend.ai: 一个寒冷而多雾的夜晚，你走在一条昏暗的小巷中。本应每隔几米就有一盏灯，但它们似乎没有一盏能正常工作；在这样的夜晚，甚至连月亮也无法照亮你的道路。你独自一人在黑暗中，不禁思考：“即使某处有一盏正常工作的灯，它能在多大程度上照亮我的道路？”现在，回到家中，你想计算出这个答案。
可以将小巷建模为一条长度为 n$$$n$$$ 米的线段。雾的密度均匀，每经过一米，雾会使灯光衰减为原来的 1−p$$$1-p$$$ 倍。某一点的亮度等于每盏灯到达该点的光的总和。放置一些灯后，你想计算若干点处的亮度。

input.ai: 一行包含两个整数 n$$$n$$$ 和 q$$$q$$$，以及一个实数 p$$$p$$$(1≤n,q≤2⋅105,0<p<1$$$1\leq n, q\leq 2\cdot10^5, 0  \lt  p  \lt  1$$$)，分别表示小巷的长度、查询次数和雾的密度。雾的密度 p$$$p$$$ 给出时小数点后最多有 6$$$6$$$ 位。
q$$$q$$$ 行，每行包含以下三种查询类型之一：'+ b x'：给定两个整数 b$$$b$$$ 和 x$$$x$$$(1≤b≤109$$$1\leq b \leq 10^9$$$ 且 1≤x≤n$$$1\leq x \leq n$$$)，在位置 x$$$x$$$ 放置一盏亮度为 b$$$b$$$ 的灯。
'- b x'：给定整数 b$$$b$$$ 和 x$$$x$$$(1≤b≤109$$$1\leq b \leq 10^9$$$ 且 1≤x≤n$$$1\leq x \leq n$$$)，移除位于位置 x$$$x$$$ 的一盏亮度为 b$$$b$$$ 的灯。保证之前在该位置放置过一盏亮度相同的灯。
'? x'：给定一个整数 x$$$x$$$(1≤x≤n$$$1\leq x \leq n$$$)，计算位置 x$$$x$$$ 处的亮度。

output.ai: 可以证明，亮度可以表示为一个分数 PQ$$$\frac{P}{Q}$$$，其中 Q$$$Q$$$ 不被 109+7$$$10^9+7$$$ 整除。对于每个类型为 '?' 的查询，在一行中输出 P⋅Q−1mod109+7$$$P\cdot Q^{-1} \bmod 10^9+7$$$。
